review_note: Reviewed 2026-10-24 from completed native CASCI character in both bases and 24 compact CASSCF/CASPT2-F12 fixed-point comparisons. Select CAS(7,6), source 18-23 at 2 angstrom: retained C(1)-S(3) sigma/sigma-star (18/23), the reorganizing cleavage/CH2S pi pair (19/22), and the SH frontier pair (20/21). Relative to each space's own 30 angstrom D1 asymptote, CAS(7,6) minus CAS(5,4) at 2 angstrom is +1.0982 kcal/mol in aDZ-F12 and +1.1140 in aTZ-F12, despite the added pair occupations being near 1.97/0.03. This coordinate-dependent difference motivates retaining the pair; absolute energy lowering alone does not. The 30-to-42 angstrom shifts of these compact potentials are below 0.002 kcal/mol. Two equally weighted doublets support the orbitals; only D1 is a reactive path. Near/far orbital character reorganizes, so no overlap, angular convergence or relaxed-connectivity validation is claimed. Use direct CASPT2-F12 aDZ/aTZ CBS, power 3.7. Production relaxed scans and their existing review gates must verify fragment identity and root/subspace continuity. Standalone relaxation diagnostics are retired at the user's request.
